limitations: The saved arrays are already associated and aligned. This export does not rerun the evaluator or reconstruct raw timestamp association.
The arrays retain their source field names and quaternion component ordering; no pose-convention conversion is performed.
A dash denotes scale was not fitted. Source panels a/b omit scale; panel c explicitly records fixed scale 1.0; panel d records a fitted scale.
These comparison values are separate from the benchmark's drift-valid ATE/RPE aggregates.
